trails.why: The Hohe Köpfe is a twin-summit mountain of the Rätikon, in the Galina group above Frastanz and Nenzing.

trails.name: Großer Woising summit
trails.why: The Großer Woising is a high summit of the Totes Gebirge on the Styria–Upper Austria border.

trails.name: Nebelhorn summit
trails.why: The Nebelhorn is a mountain of the Loferer Steinberge near the Tyrol–Salzburg border.

trails.name: Schänzlespitz summit
trails.why: Schänzlespitze is a mountain of Bavaria, Germany.

trails.name: Sattelnock summit
trails.why: The Sattelnock is a summit of the Gailtal Alps with a soft, rounded shape unusual in this rugged range.

trails.name: Breitenkopfhütte hut
trails.why: The Breitenkopfhütte is a hut of the German Alpine Club in the Mieming range, under a rock overhang below the west face of the Breitenkopf.

trails.name: Großer Beilstein summit
trails.why: The Großer Beilstein is a summit of the Hochschwab group in Styria.

trails.name: Torkopf summit
trails.why: For sure-footed hikers an easy mountain walk from Hinterriß through the Rontal or Tortal and over the Torscharte: about 3 hours up, 2 hours down, 1,100 m of climb.

trails.name: Ahornkogl summit
trails.why: The Ahornkogl is a mountain of the Wölz Tauern in Styria.

trails.name: Brentenjoch summit
trails.why: The Brentenjoch is a high mountain of the Tannheim range in the Allgäu Alps, mostly in Tyrol.

trails.name: Windhöhe / Pišenca summit
trails.why: The Windhöhe is a 1,995 m mountain of the Košuta group in the western Karawanks.

trails.name: Feigentalhimmel summit
trails.why: The Feigentalhimmel is a high summit of the Totes Gebirge on the border between Styria and Upper Austria.

trails.name: Riegerin summit
trails.why: The Riegerin is a high mountain of the Hochschwab group in Styria.

trails.name: Zinken summit
trails.why: The Zinken is a high mountain of the Hochschwab group in Styria.

trails.name: Demeljoch summit
trails.why: The Demeljoch is a mountain at the border between Bavaria, Germany, and Tyrol, Austria. The summit can be reached through a hiking trail starting near the easternmost point of the Sylvensteinsee.

trails.name: Fäustling summit
trails.why: The Fäustling, also called Edlerkogel, is a mountain of the Hetzau ridge, the loneliest corner of the Totes Gebirge.

trails.name: Hochtörl summit
trails.why: The Hochtörl is a summit in the north-west of the Tennengebirge, demanding despite its modest height: steep flanks, exposed position.

trails.name: Bärenwandkopf summit
trails.why: The Bärenwandkopf is a high mountain of the Karwendel in Tyrol.

trails.name: Neustein summit
trails.why: The Neustein is a mountain of the Totes Gebirge; its striking north-west face towers over the Vorderer Lahngangsee.

trails.name: Festlbeilstein summit
trails.why: The Festlbeilstein is a high mountain of the Hochschwab group in Styria.

trails.name: Tauern summit
trails.why: The Tauern is a high mountain of the Ammergau Alps in the Außerfern, Tyrol.

trails.name: Rappenklammspitze summit
trails.why: The Rappenklammspitze is a high mountain of the Karwendel in Tyrol.

trails.name: Rinnkogel summit
trails.why: The Rinnkogel is a high mountain of the Salzkammergut range in the state of Salzburg.

trails.name: Rohrauer Größtenberg summit
trails.why: The Rohrauer Größtenberg is a mountain of the Sengsengebirge whose 700 m north wall drops steeply into the Niklbachtal.

trails.name: Goppaschrofen summit
trails.why: The Goppaschrofen is a mountain of the Rätikon, in the Galina group above Frastanz.

trails.name: Backenstein summit
trails.why: The Backenstein rises about 1,000 m above the Grundlsee with a striking 600 m rock face, the home mountain of Grundlsee.

trails.name: Hochtürnach summit
trails.why: The Türnach is a small massif of the southern Ybbstal Alps, above the Salza valley near Mariazell.

trails.name: Großer Größtenberg summit
trails.why: The Großer Größtenberg is the highest point of the Reichraminger Hintergebirge.

trails.name: Freiger See lake
trails.why: The Freiger See is a lake in a high valley of the Stubai Alps, just north of the border with South Tyrol.

trails.name: Reedsee lake
trails.why: The Reedsee is a mountain lake in the municipality of Bad Gastein, in the Austrian state of Salzburg.

trails.name: Vallülasee lake
trails.why: Lake Vallüla is a mountain lake located in Montafon, Austria. This secluded area on Mount Vallüla can only be reached on foot due to its high elevation and rough terrain.

trails.name: Reinkarsee lake
trails.why: Reinkarsee is a lake of Tyrol, Austria, northeast of the Kröndlhorn. It is drained by the Windauer Ache, a tributary of the Brixentaler Ache.

trails.name: Wiegensee lake
trails.why: The Wiegensee is a mountain lake north-east of Partenen, in the municipality of Gaschurn in Vorarlberg.

trails.name: Ahornsee lake
trails.why: Ahornsee is a lake of Upper Austria.

trails.name: Sefenspitze summit
trails.why: A mountain in the centre of the Tannheim range, rising north above the Tannheimer Tal.

trails.name: Ronberg summit
trails.why: The Ronberg is a high mountain of the Karwendel in Tyrol.

trails.name: Hochfeiler - Gran Pilastro summit
trails.why: The Hochfeiler is a mountain, 3,510 metres high, and the highest peak in the Zillertal Alps on the border between Tyrol, Austria, and South Tyrol, Italy.

trails.name: Hochgall - Monte Collalto
trails.why: The Hochgall is a mountain of the Rieserferner group in the High Tauern. the summit is in South Tyrol, Italy, just 500 m from the Austrian border.

trails.name: Hohenzollernhaus hut
trails.why: The Hohenzollernhaus is a hut of the Starnberg section of the German Alpine Club in the Ötztal Alps.

trails.name: Matschuner Joch pass
trails.why: The Matschuner Joch is a high pass of the Silvretta in Vorarlberg, linking the Novatal and the Garneratal.
